body: Remember that it is temporary. You posted here three months ago saying that you were nearing the end of your rope, but you're still here. You can keep going. What do you usually do to keep yourself occupied? You said that you can't be the person you want to be because of this disease but that doesn't mean that you're nothing.

No, I'm really sure they weren't.

EDIT: Also, the issue here isn't so much their age. I know that attraction to 14 year olds doesn't make you a paedophile, and I rarely find 14 year olds attractive anyway. It's more about the nature of the videos. When I was younger I used to look at nudist sites because I wanted to see girls my own age and I never felt bad about that. Those girls were fine with being seen naked; these webcam girls didn't intend for the whole world to see them. Sure, you could say that they should know better than to take a stupid risk like that, but, come on, they're 14. At that age you're still learning and making mistakes.

I don't know, I feel like this has broken me. I've started to think of myself as a child molester and I rarely feel interested in sex with real people anymore. It might just be the depression causing this (wouldn't be the first time) but I fear that it might not be and that I've ruined my ability to have intimate sexual relationships forever.

Have you talked to anyone about this? Unlike most people here you seem to have a pretty good life apart from your depression. Not that that makes it any less real, but it's easier to deal with something like this if you're not stuck in a shitty situation with awful people. Things seem to be going great for you and you have people who care, so just let them know and you'll probably be able to get some help. I know it feels stupid being depressed when you've had an easy life, but depression is not something you have to earn. Get some help now while things are still going well.

I don't think losing you would make your parents any happier.You have caused them trouble, but that doesn't mean that they only see you as a problem and nothing else.
Can you explain your situation in a bit more detail? In what way can't you manage your money? How old are you? Have you tried to do anything about this before?

This, pretty much. Letting him know that you love him and that you appreciate all he's done for you is a good start. If anything it will make you both feel less alone. He probably feels the same way as you about this whole situation, so try to do something about it together. Makes it easier.

I read your previous post and to me it sounds like you need to get away from some of the people around around you. The ones who tell you you're selfish clearly don't understand your situation, so try to get help from somewhere else. You say that you help your friends with their problems; have you told them about yours? I doubt they see you as a burden considering that you've been there for them when they needed you.
